visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a static digital illustration of a male anime character with messy black hair and a distinctive white streak. He features sharp, narrow yellow eyes and a defined jawline, looking towards the left in a side profile. He is clad in a dark, high-collared cloak with a bold red interior lining, partially revealing a muscular torso. The background is a nocturnal urban cityscape under a large, glowing yellow moon, with purple-tinted clouds and silhouette-like skyscrapers. A logo for "狂震蛋先事" is visible in the top-left, and "CLIP STUDIO PAINT" in the top-right corner. (2) The scene dissolves into a second illustration depicting the same character transformed into a wolf-human hybrid with dark fur. His eyes now glow with an intense red light as he sits in a thoughtful, crouched posture with one hand near his face. The setting transitions to a dramatic sunset, characterized by vibrant orange, pink, and purple hues across the sky, with the city buildings now silhouetted against the bright light. The character's cloak remains identical, though his physical form is distinctly lupine, featuring furry ears and a tail. (3) The video continues as a montage, cycling back and forth between the human and wolf-hybrid versions of the character. Each transition is a smooth dissolve, showing variations in background lighting—from the cool blues of night to the warm oranges of dawn and the flat, bright colors of daytime. The focus remains strictly on the character's upper body and profile. No additional objects or characters are introduced. (4) In the final segment, a large overlay of white text appears at the bottom of the screen against the sunset background. The text details an invitation to the 2025 Taichung Illustration Fair. The character in his wolf form remains static in the center, looking away from the camera. The overall visual style is consistent with high-quality 2D digital character art.
